steps.text: Talk to Reldo in the Varrock Castle library.
choices: I'm in search of a quest.

steps.text: Search the marked bookcase for a book, then read it.

choices: Okay, I've read that book about the Shield of Arrav.

steps.text: To start the quest as the Black Arm Gang, talk to Charlie the Tramp in south Varrock to start.
choices: Is there anything down this alleyway?
I'm looking for the Black Arm Gang.
Do you think they would let me join?

steps.text: Talk to Katrine down the alley to the west.
choices: I've heard you're the Black Arm Gang.
I'd rather not reveal my sources.
I want to become a member of your gang.
Well, you can give me a try can't you?

steps.text: Get the weapon storeroom key from another player.  If you cannot trade, have them use the key on you to drop it at your feet.
Go up the ladder in south east Varrock to the Phoenix Weapon Storeroom.
Kill the Weaponsmaster, or have someone else kill him.
Go back down from the storeroom.
Return to Katrine with the crossbows.
Go up the stairs in the Black Arm Gang base.
Search the cupboard for half of the Shield of Arrav.
Search the cupboard for half of the Shield of Arrav.
Trade one of your certificate halves for the other half with another player. If you cannot trade, use the certificate on them to drop it at their feet. They can do the same for you.
Use the two certificate halves together to create the certificate.
Talk to Curator Haig in the Varrock Museum.
Talk to King Roald in Varrock Castle to finish the quest.
